title: Cheerios maker General Mills stock tumbles after sales disappoint
主要内容: General Mills, the maker of Cheerios, saw its stock fall after its fourth-quarter revenue fell short of analysts' estimates. The company reported net sales for its North American retail segment, which accounts for more than half of its revenue, fell 2% during its fiscal fourth quarter ended May 26. The decline was partially attributed to a drop in its U.S. snacks business, including products like Chex Mix and Nature Valley granola bars. Despite this, General Mills beat Wall Street's earnings expectations, reporting adjusted earnings of 83 cents per share, surpassing the anticipated 77 cents per share. The company also released its fiscal 2020 outlook, expecting organic net sales to increase by 1% to 2% and adjusted full-year earnings per share to rise by 3% to 5% from the $3.22 per share earned in fiscal 2019. CEO Jeff Harmening stated the company has plans to accelerate organic sales growth while maintaining strong margins and cash discipline.
